response.description:
Azure Files now supports access
from macOS using Entra ID authentication (Public Preview), enabling secure,
identity-based access to file shares for cross-platform teams. This expands
support for modern workflows, allowing users on macOS to seamlessly access and
collaborate on shared data alongside Windows environments. Key benefits include:
 Enhanced security posture:
Password-less access from macOS using Entra ID - no credential prompts or
storage account keys—enforced by Conditional Access, MFA, and AES-256
encryption Reduced operational overhead:
Eliminate key management; access is provisioned and governed through Entra ID
groups  No Active Directory dependency:
Enable full access to Azure Files using cloud identities - no domain
controllers required  True identity-based access model:
Kerberos authentication with Azure RBAC and NTFS ACLs for precise, layered
access control  Accelerated AI workflows:
Seamless access to large datasets from macOS to support faster experimentation
and development  Reach out to azurefiles@microsoft.com with questions. Learn
more.
response.title: Public Preview: Secure, Modern Access to Azure Files on macOS with MS Entra ID
